This is Otis. Since he was adopted he has a non-negotiable bedtime ritual. Of  Getting tucked in bed with mom . Then those satisfied licks of victory. perfect angel please leave him a heart ❤️

description.description: A wrinkled Shar-Pei stands on a white bed in front of a glowing television screen. A person lying under the covers lifts the blanket, and the dog crawls underneath to settle in.
